candidates.explanation: The size check is inverted: it throws PayloadTooLargeException when file.fileSize < maxFileSize. Small files (200 KB) are rejected with 413, and only files at or above the limit (e.g. 20 MB) pass. It should throw when fileSize > maxFileSize.

fix.description: Flip the comparison so the exception is thrown only when the file exceeds the limit: use `file.fileSize > maxFileSize`.
